tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// rang byung rdo rje'i gsung mgur thor bu bzhugs so/

༄༅// na mo ratna gu ru/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// byin gyis rlabs par mdzad du gsol// phyi rol nam mkha' stong pa la// 'byung ba dkyil 'khor du ma brtan// skye 'gags snang yang 'dus ma byas// phyi'i rten 'brel gzhi ma yin// sems nyid dag pa'i dbyings nyid la// phung po khams sogs du mar snang*// snang yang skye 'gag ngo bo stong// nang gi rten 'brel gnas lugs yin// phyi rol rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyis// rgya mtsho ri gling thams cad brten// rtsa shing lo 'bras 'phel zhing rgyas// sna tshogs sdud dang 'jigs par byed// 'du byed rlung ltar g.yo ba yis// las dang nyon mongs chu tshogs bskyed// gzugs sogs skye 'gags du ma rnams// 'du byed dbang gi 'byung ba yin// phyi rol me yi rkyen gyis ni// drod dang smin dang gsal bar byed// rtsa shing dngos po kun bsregs cing*// rten med skye zhing 'gag par snang*// tshor ba me lce lta bu ni// yul gyi rkyen gyi rab 'bar zhing*// blang dor 'dod sred byas nas kyang*// rten med sems kyi ngang du yal// phyi rol 'byung ba'i chu bo ni// sna tshogs ri glang kun bskyed cing*// dngos po rlan dang 'phel bar byed// rten med rang bzhin 'gag par snang*// 'du shes chu bo smig rgyu 'dra// yul la mtshan 'dzin skyed byed cing*// las dang nyon mongs chu bor ldan// rten med skye zhing 'gag par snang*// phyi rol sa rdo ri brag kun// g.yo med brtan pa ltar snang yang*// skad cig mi rtag 'jig 'gyur zhing*// rten med nam mkha'i ngang du 'gag /gzugs kyi phung por snang ba yang*// khams dang skye mched du ma rnams// brten snang skad cig skye 'gag byed// sems kyi cho 'phrul ngang du 'gag /glu ngo mtshar dpe don bcu po 'di// dus mtha'i rnal 'byor rdo rje yis// nyams la shar nas blangs pa lags// 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob par shog

/ces pa 'di chos rje rang byung rdo rje yis/ rin chen zangs bzang pa rnams la dbang bskur mdzad dus zhus pa la gsungs pa'o/// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos// gnyis su med par mngon gyur pa// sgyu ma lta bu'i rnam 'phrul du// rtog pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// phyi rol snang ba sna tshogs 'di// rang gi sems kyi cho 'phrul ste// gzhan du bden pa rdul tsam med// de phyir rang gis ngang du ltos// rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo de// sgyu ma smig rgyu'i ngo bo ltar// snang yang bden par ma grub pas// rang grol gcig tu klod la zhog /de ltar ma rtogs sems can la// snying rje chen po rgyun du bsgom// sems can bden par mi 'dzin par// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med yin// de ltar ston pa'i bla ma la// mos gus rgyun chad med par bsgom// nges shes chen po gsol ba gdab// rtag tu byin rlabs 'byung ba yin// sems nyid rten cing 'brel 'byung la// 'gag med rtsal sbyong du ma yi// rang ngo sems la sbyangs pa na// sna tshogs yon tan du ma 'byung*// lta stangs gnad du brteg pa dngas// ma yengs ngang du 'jog pa de// zhi gnas 'grub par byed pa yin// lus ngag yid gsum longs spyod rnams// rtag tu sems can don du bsngo// smon lam rgya chen rgyun du gdab// yon tan sems la 'char ba yin// zhes pa 'di byi ba lo la bde chen steng gi ri la byon dus gsungs pa'o/// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// byin gyis brlabs par mdzad du gsol// man ngag dam pa dbyangs su len// skal bar ldan rnams snyan gsan mdzod// theg chen bla ma dam pa la// mos gus tshul bzhin byas nas kyang*// nges shes rgyun chad med par bsgom// byin rlabs sems la 'jug pa yin// dang po rnam rtog dben pa dang*// ri khrod dben pa brten byas nas// rnam par 'dzin pa de// zhi gnas bskyed par byed pa yin// thos pa rgyud la brten pa dang*// shes rab snang ba bskyed pa dang*// chos kun bdag med rtog byed pa// lhag mthong bskyed par byed pa yin// ma yengs rtse gcig 'jog pa dang*// bsam gtan goms par byed pa dang*// snang stong sgyu ma ltar sbyong ba// 'bras bu rtog par byed pa yin// snying rje chen pos zin pa dang*// skal ldan rnams kyi nyams su longs// ces pa rnam bar phug tu'o/// /

༈ na mo gu ru/ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// byin gyis rlabs par mdzad du gsol// tshigs 'di la 'dir bzhugs snyan gsan mdzod// don dgos ched gda' na thugs la zhog /dal 'byor mi lus thob nas kyang*// theg chen bla ma rnyed gyur nas// chos tshul bzhin nyams su mi len par/ rtsab rtsub mang kyang dgos rgyu chung*// rang lus dben par mi shes shing*// sgro 'dogs nang nas ma chod par// phyi rol gnas kun bsgrod byas kyang*// thang chad sdug bsngal myong ba lags// snang ba dpe cha ma shar cing*// gcig shes kun grol ma byung na// yig tshogs nor rtsis byas lags kyang*// glu mkhan chos bzhin dgos pa med// dben gnas sems su shes nas kyang*// 'gog pa nyon mongs rang sar 'gog /sbyang na ting 'dzin phyogs med sbyong*// 'di sgrub na ngo mtshar che ba lags// shes rab rang byung sgron me 'di// thams cad sems su thag chod cing*// sems nyid spros bral dbyings su dag /rtogs na mkhas pa'i mthar thug yin// thog med dus na 'brel pa yin// khams gsum sems thams cad la// snying rje nang nas bskyed byas nas// theg dman lam dus 'gro dgos med// de phyir stong nyid snying rje dang*// zab mo'i bsam gtan rgyun du bsgom// don thams cad bsdus kyang de las med// de 'dir bzhugs snyan du 'bul ba lags// zhes pa'i mgur 'di/ byi ba lo zla ba rgyal la/ 'brug gong gsal gyi dgon par tshogs gral du gsungs pa'o/// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ 'khor 'das ro mnyam rang bzhin nyid// chos dbyings gcig gi dkyil 'khor// rtog pa lhun grub ngo bo nyid// bla ma mchog la phyag 'tshal lo// o rgyan padma 'byung gnas kyi// gangs can 'gro ba 'dul ba'i phyir// sna tshogs rdzu 'phrul bsam mi khyab// spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs rje yin// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi// chos rnams kun gyi rnam 'phrul ste// sna tshogs sgyu ma'i rol pa la// chu zla lta bur rtogs na yin// dngos por snang ba thams cad kun// rang bzhin stong zhing dag pa ste// blo yi spros pas ma bslad pa// 'dzin med mkha' ltar dag na yin// rnam rtog tha mal gyi shes pa 'di// bying rmugs kyi phyogs su ma lhung bar// bde gsal mi rtogs mnyam 'brel par// dran pas skyong na sgom pa yin// thub pa'i bka' las byung ba ltar// rang 'dod zhen pas ma bcings par// 'gro la phan pa'i rje 'jug pa// rgyun du spyod na spyod pa yin// srid dang zhi bar mi gnas zhing*/

'khor 'das phyogs su ma lhung bar// ji lta ji snyed mnyam nyid du// lhun gyi grub na 'bras bu yin// lta sgom spyod pa 'bras bu yin// rang bzhin gtan la 'bebs pa'i glu// bsam yas 'chim phu'i rtse mo ru// rang bzhin ngag tu brjod pa lags// zhes pa 'di/ chos rje rin po che rang byung rdo rje yis/ bsam yas 'chim phu'i rtse mo ru/ o rgyan gyi mkhan po padma 'byung gnas kyi sgrub gnas su gsungs pa'o/// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ rje bla ma dam pa bka' drin can// gnyis med ye shes ston pa po// lhan cig skyes pa'i ngo bo nyid// chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo// ri bo gangs can shar phyogs su// dus mtha'i rnal 'byor rdo rje la// dpon slob kyi gzung 'dzin mi gda'o// snang ba rang sems su nges shes skyes// bsam shing rang sems su nges shes skyes// nor dang so sor snang ba sgyu ma ste// nor du rtog mkhan 'khrul pa lags// dus mtha'i rnal 'byor rdo rje ni// longs spyod kyi mngon zhen mi gda'o// yul snang sems su nges shes skyes// bsam zhing rang sems la nges shes skyes// snying po'i yul snang rdzun pa ste// snying rje'i mkhan rnam rtog lags// dus mtha'i rnal 'byor rdo rje ni// blang dor gyi rtog pa mi dga'o// snying rje rang sems su nges shes skyes// bsam zhing rang sems la nges shes skyes// chos su snang ba 'khrul pa ste// bya'o snyams na 'dzin rtog lags// dus mtha'i rnal 'byor rdo rje ni// chos kun chos nyid kyi ngang du du thal// gnyis med kyi sems las nges shes skyes// bsam zhing rang sems la nges shes skyes// ming tshig brjod pa yang ye shes ste// brjod med kyi don yang ye shes lags// dus mtha'i rnal 'byor rdo rje ni// brjod ma brjod blang dor mi gda'o// sems ye shes kyi ngo bor nges shes skyes// bsam shing rang sems la nges shes skyes// sgom sems 'dzin gyi dmigs gsal rtogs pa ste// dmigs med la sgom rgyu ma mthong bas// dus mtha'i rnal 'byor rdo rje ni// dmigs dang dmigs med mnyam par rtogs// sems bsam gtan yin par nges shes skyes// bsam shing rang sems la nges shes skyes// slad kyi nyams su len pa kun// rje grub thob gong ma'i rjes su snyogs// grub thob gtsang ba'i skyo skyes la// rten nas kho bos nang du bltas// dbyangs mchod par 'bul lo skyes chen rnams// don thugs la zhog cig skal ldan kun// zhes pa 'di chos rje rang byung rdo rje yis/

rkog 'phrang du gtsang pa rgya yis skyo skyes drug blangs pa'i dus gsungs so/// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// 'dir bzhugs skal ldan snyan gson la// dgos ched gcig gda' na thugs la zhog /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po nas// skye rga na 'chi'i chu bo 'bab// nyon mongs chu srin du mas gang*// thar med bza' klong 'khrugs pa la// myur du rgal bar 'dod pa rnams// dal 'byor gru chen thob dus su// rgas pa'i skyon gyi ma gos par// tshul khrims bzang po'i zag ldan gyi// sbyin pa'i yo byad ldan bya zhing*// tshul khrims skya ba ldan pa dang*// bzod pa'i ba dan g.yo bas brgyan// theg chen bla ma'i mnyen pa dang*// bsam gtan zas kyi legs 'tsho zhing*// shes rab chen pos legs brtags ste// 'khor ba'i klong du ma shor bar// thar pa'i gling du bgrod par bya// yang gcig gson dang skal ldan kun// tshe 'dir brtson pa ma bskyed na// rig pa'i khye'u chung yengs la dga'// 'dod yon snang ba brid la mkhas// 'khor ba'i dba' klong 'jigs pa che// rnam rtog g.yengs ba dgra thabs mkhas// bying rgod skyon 'di sna tshogs 'byung*// 'khor ba'i klong du 'chor nyan gda'// de phyir rgyal ba'i snyigs dus 'dir// theg chen bla ma'i bka' bzhin bsgrub// zang zing g.yeng ba ring du spongs// dben gnas ri khrod dgon pa bsten// 'dod yon zas kyi sred pa chos// 'khor ba'i 'brel ba kun chod la// de ltar brjod pa'i mgur dbyangs 'di// dus mtha'i rnal 'byor rdo rje yis// ri bo gangs can gyi shar phyogs kyi// rtsā ri'i gzhol du blang pa lags// zhes pa'i chos rje rang byung rdo rje yis/ glang lo zla ba gsum pa'i nyi shu gsum la/ bang ram spangs gis tshogs gral du gsungs pa'o/// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rang rgyud grol bar byin gyis rlobs// snyigs dus gangs can shar phyogs su// byung ba'i rnal 'byor 'di skad lo// dpag med sbyang bar las 'phro yis// dal 'byor mi lus thob dus su// g.yeng ba'i sad la mi bskur bar// tshul bzhin nyams su blang yang 'tshal// rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul dpag med kyi// bla ma'i rnam thar bstan pa la// rang sems dag pa'i mos gus kyi// rtse cig dag snang bskyed kyang 'tshal// nyon mongs rnam par dben pa yid// ri khrod bas mtha' nyams dga' bar// rtse cig dben pa bstan yang 'tshal// rang sems nang du bkug pa yi// bde gsal mi rtog ting 'dzin ni// 'bad med rgyud la skyes pa'i tshe// g.yeng ba'i rkyen la mi bskur 'tshal// thog med las kyi bag chags kyi// lus sems la bar du gcod pa yi// rkyen ngan sdug bsngal thams cad kyang*// lam du bslang zhing bsgom yang 'tshal// zag med rgyal ba'i snying po yi// rnam 'phrul rten 'brel shes rab 'di// bying rmug skyon gyi ma bslad par// dag gsal gnyen po spro yang 'tshal// bdag dang sems can spro yang 'tshal// bdag dang sems can bdag med kyang*// snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin gyis// rgyun du rjes su bzungs sems kyis// 'khor ba ji srid bsngo yang 'tshal// nyams len lam gyi sgron me'i mgur// rnam rtog 'phro 'du la brten nas// nags phu dpal gyi dgon par bris// skal ldan rnams kyi gdams ngag mdzod/

zhes chos rje rang byung rdo rje'i gsungs so/// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos// bla ma dge 'dun 'dus pa'i gtso// rang sems chos skur ngo sprod pa'i// rje 'gro ba 'dren la phyag 'tshal lo// snyigs ma lnga ldan rtsod pa'i dus/ rgyal ba thugs rje'i mnga' bdag gi /'gro la sna tshogs thabs tshul gyis// theg pa bla na med pa gsungs// las dang skal bar ldan pa yi// grub thob brgyud pa'i gdams ngag thob// mdo rgyud bstan bcos dpag med shes// yang dag lta ba ma nor rnyed// da tshul bzhin nyams su len pa na// dben gnas 'du 'dzi med pa yi// tsā ri dben pa'i nye 'khor dang*// nags phu dpal ldan lta bu yi// 'jig rten rnam g.yengs med pa ru// bsgrub pa tshul bzhin byas na legs// gnas 'di ni phyogs med ri bo'i rtse// phal gyi bsgrod par rab dka' zhing*// 'du 'dzi'i bab chos rnam par dben// gang rtsi dpal ldan ti ci'i drugs// gang ri mdzes pa'i phreng bas bskor// brag ri mchod rten 'phreng ba 'dra// nags tshal ljon pa du mas gang*// bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gang 'dod bab// spangs ljongs shin du mdzes pa la// sman dang bza' ba'i ro bcud kyis// rdzas rnams du mas rab gang zhing*// bsgrub pa 'phel ba'i gnas mchog yin// 'dir bzhugs skyes bu dam pa rnams// bsgrub pa nyams su len pa yin// bzang 'dod mkhan gyi rtog ldan dang*// mi mgo bskor ba'i dge bshes dang*// lto gdung can gyi sgom chen dang*// rnam g.yengs 'dod pa'i skyes bu kun// gnas 'dir phyin kyang 'dug mi tshul// de phyir sgrub pa 'phel ba ste// snyigs dus dben gnas e ma ho// rnal 'byor rang byung rdo rje ni// rang gi nyams su myong pa'i don// sgro 'dogs nang nas ma chod na// phyi ru go yang mi phan pas// phyi nang gcig tu gdar sha chod// yod pa'i longs spyod mi 'dor cing*// med pa 'dod par mi bya ste// dka' thub don med mi byed cing*// cung zad dka' yang ting 'dzin spel// mi shes gzhan la mi bstan cing*// shes kyang dpe 'khyud byed pa dor// mi nyan slob ma mi bsdu zhing*// gus ldan gzhan du skrad mi bya// nyams myong gzhan la mi smra zhing*// sgro 'dogs sems la lan smra bya// nga bzang tshul 'chos mi bya zhing*// dman pa'i tshul chos mi 'dor bar// mtha' gnyis rnam par spangs nas kyang*// thob bsam bsgom la brten bya zhes// go nas ngag tu smras pa lags/

slad ma nyams len mdzad pa rnams// de ltar dgongs la bsgrub pa mdzod// zhes chos rje rang byung rdo rjes gsungs so/// / ༈ na mo ratna gu ru/ 'gro ba kun la thugs rje can// skyabs shākya'i rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod kyi smon lam dpag med kyang*// log pa'i sems can dmu rgod rnams// thugs rjes thul bar dka' ba yin// 'dul bar mdzad pa shin tu rmad// kye ma rang byung ming can bdag /khyed la mos pas gsol bar bgyid// bstan pa'i snyigs ma lnga ldan dus// bstan pa 'dzin pa'i dge bshes kun// pho tshug tshul 'chos spyod pa yi// blun po dad byed ngo mtshar yang*// rang don nyon mongs ma bri bas// nga khyod chos la byed pa de/ chos spong nye ba 'di ma mtshar// dang po gzhon nu rab byung zhing*// 'phags pa'i rgyal mtshan thogs pa 'di// shin tu ngo mtshar rmad byung yang*// dar bab cung zad rnam pa'i tshe// nyon mongs longs spyod ngan 'gror ltung*// phan btsun ser gzung 'di ma mtshar// mkhas pa'i drung du blo gros can// sde snod gsum la slob pa 'di// de bas rab tu ngo mtshar yang*// bshad cing ston par ming thog nas// chos min spyod cing nan chags spangs// rang rgyud rings pa 'di ma mtshar// bla ma'i gdam ngag thob nas kyang*// dben pa tshul bzhin sgom pa de// shin tu ngo mtshar che lags kyang*// bsam gtan nyams myong bra srig la// brten nas rdzun du smra ba 'di// bdag gzhan bslu bas 'di ma mtshar// bde gsal mi rtog ting nge 'dzin// skyes nas nyon mongs zhi ba 'di// khyad par rmad du ngo mtshar kyang*// 'du shes bkag pa'i nga rgyal la// zhen nas 'du shes med pa'i ltar*// yi khom gyur pa 'di ma mtshar// thos bsam bla ma'i byin rlabs kyi// bsam gtan shes rab 'brel ba yi// ngo bo go ba kun la ngo mtshar yang*// rtogs pa brtan por ma gyur par// gzhan gyi the gtong bsod chung gi

/phyir la khrid pa 'di ma mtshar// rang gi nyams su blangs nas kyang*// 'jig rten sred pa chod pa 'di// sred las grol bar ngo mtshar phangs// snying rje kun slong chung ba yin// thabs mkhas gzhan don bor ba de// theg dman ltung ba 'di ma mtshar// blo ldan theg chen rig ldan pas// shes rab snying rje 'dzom pa yi// sdug bsngal dang len 'di mtshar yang*// bdag dang sems can gdod ma nas// sgyu 'dra mngon du ma gyur pas// 'khor bar ltung ba 'di ma mtshar// sdug bsngal kun 'byung la brten pa'i// ma dag pa yi zhing dor nas// dag pa'i zhing sbyang ngo mtshar kyang*// zhing kun rang snang ma shes nas// blang dor byas pas sdug bsngal bskyed// mnyam nyid ma gyur 'di ma mtshar// de sogs dpag tu med pa yi// ngo mtshar ngo mtshar ma yin pa'i// rang byung sems la rtog lags kyang*// bshad kyang gzhan la mi phan cing*// slar yang zur zar mthong srid pas// mnyam pa nyid la klod la zhog /'gro kun mtha' gnyis spangs nas kyang*// rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas par shog /nags phu dpal gyi ri khrod du// rnam rtog 'phros pas dbyangs su blangs/// / ༈ na mo ratna gu ru/ dpal ldan bla ma la phyag 'tshal// e ma dus mtha'i rnal 'byor pa// bdag mkhos chung ri khrod gnas pa 'di// g.yeng ba'i sad kyis ma khyer na// bla mas byin gyis rlob par nges// bdag 'dra rang byung ming can 'di// dpal ldan khyung rdzong zhes bya ru/ rtse cig bsgrub pa byed dus su// khyi lo dbyar zla 'bring po yi// yar ngo'i nub gcig rmi lam na// ri bo rin chen spungs 'dra'i ngos// thugs rje'i bdag po spyan ras gzigs// ston zla'i dkyil 'khor ltar dkar ba// de mdun mi gtsang 'khor ba yi// g.yang sa 'jigs pa 'dug pa rmis// de na rnal 'byor tai lo pa// bzhugs nas bdag la 'di skad gsung*// zang zing bdud kyi bslu brid yin// khyod de la chags par ma byed ang*// 'khor ba dug gi rang bzhin yin// 'di la 'dre bar ma byed ang*// skal ldan slob ma nor bu 'dra// bzang po byung na skyong gcig ang*// thun mongs nyams myong dpag med kyang*// bden par 'dzin par ma byed gsungs// de nas mi snang yal nas thal// e ma bdag 'dra rnal 'byor 'di// glang lo zla ba dgu pa'i// yar tshes ngo yi tho rangs na// dkar ser dmar ljang mthing 'od 'khrug

/'od zer sna tshogs mdzes dkyil na// paṇḍi ta ni dri med sku// rab gsal sgrib pa med par bzhugs// zhal nas gdams ngag ma gsungs kyang*// bhi ma la mi tra yin par nges// bar do 'od kyi zer thig gi// gnad kyi snying po khong nas shes// e ma rang byung ming can bdag /dpal ldan karma'i yang dgon na// de ltar rdzogs chen gnad bkrol lo// bdag ni sangs rgyas byang chub sems// kun gyi thugs rjes dgongs pa snyams// yos bu dgun zla 'bring po yi// nub gcig 'di ltar rmi lam na// rin chen 'od du 'bar gyur pa// rgyal ba'i mchod rten drung du ni// rab tu mdzes pa'i dge slong gsum// shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung*/ mgrin gcig skad kyi rab gsungs ste// bdag gis rtse cig yid brtan nyan// de nas zab mo'i mdo sde kun// mthong nas go bar gyur pa yi// blo gros bdag gi thob par gyur// 'di ltar 'khrul pa'i rmi lam la// gza' gtan yod pa ma yin kyang*// 'khrul snang bag chags dkar po la// 'dris pa'i dbang gi rmis pa rnams// gzhon nu'i ming can bzhed pa na// 'khrul snang 'di la dgyes par mdzod// 'o skol da lta lam pa la// mtshan ltas bzang ngan gang byung yang*// sgyu ma lta bur shes pa ngas// gsang bar bya ba man ngag yin// des na rdzun gyi rang bzhin 'di// gzhan la mi spel gsang bar zhu// ces pa 'di lha steng pa/ bla ma gzhon nu 'bum la gsungs so/// / ༈ na mo ratna gu ru/ kye kye brtse ba chen pos rab gang ba'i// thugs rje ldan pa rnams phyag 'tshal// thog med dus na rjes su 'brel gyur pa'i// bag chags skyon rnams zhi bar mdzad du gsol// sems kyi gsar skye rgyal bas ma gzigs shing*// thog med dus nas skad cig shes pa'i yul// 'gag pa'i rang bzhin rnam par dag gyur pa// 'di dang nyer 'brel kun tu gso ba'i yid// ma rtogs yun ring 'gro 'dir 'khor byas pas// yul med pa la yul du bzung gyur te// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya tha dad pas// bde sdug yul gyi ro la myong gyur te// skye rgas na 'chi zo chu bzhin du 'khor// dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro'i 'jig rten dang*// lha dang lha min srid pa gzhan dag du// dkar nag las kyi so sor 'phang gyur cing*// so so'i las dang skyid sdug byed pa dag

/myong ba de yang ma rig gis sgrib pas// mi dran bzhin du spyod pa 'di re mtshar// thugs rje ldan pa'i rgyal ba dpag med rnams// bgrang las 'das pa mya ngan 'das gyur kyang*// kun gyi thugs rje lcags kyus ma zin cing*// don med rnam rtog ci zhig ltar byol te// da dung 'khor ba'i klong na 'khyam pa mtshar// kye ma thugs rje'i mnga' bdag thub pa che// khyed kyi thugs rje chen po'i 'od zer gyi// cung zad tsam gcig phog par gyur mod kyang*// bdag blo shes rab stobs ni gzhan gyur cing*// ma rig sgrib pa shin tu 'thug gyur pas// rang gi blo la shin tu rmongs gyur te// de ni sangs rgyas stobs dang mi 'jigs dang*// yon tan dpag med khyed kyi thugs rje yis// skad cig nyid la 'phags pa'i sa lam dang*// ye shes snang ba bskyed par mdzad du gsol// kye ma'o bdag ni thog med 'khor rtsa nas// sbyin pa'i mthu ni chung gyur cing// tshul khrims stobs kyang rab dman pas// dus ring 'gro ba dbul ba rnams// phun tshogs longs spyod gyis 'tshal zhing*// chos kyi yongs su bskyang pa dang*// nag po 'dres mar ma gyur pa'i// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun sprin tshogs la// rnam par dag pa'i chos ston cing*// the tshom gcod par ma gyur to// 'on kyang snyigs ma'i dus su ni// rgyal sras rnams kyi rjes 'jug tu// blo'i stobs kyi 'bad byas shing*// sems can don ni ci 'grub tu// dam pa'i chos ni bsrung ba'i phyir// lus ngag yid kyi 'bad par bya// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams// smon lam chen po'i dbang gis ni// gang gi srid pa ci srid par// sna tshogs thabs kyi rol pa mdzad// de dag rjes su bslab bya zhing*// sems ni mthu dang ldan par bya// gang dag dmigs pa can rnams kyi// rgyal sras spyod la 'jug min pas// ci ltar sgyu ma rmi lam ltar// dngos rnams zhen pa med pa'i blos// rtag tu rjes su spyad par bya// dngos rnams kun la chags med pas// bzang yang gzhan don gyur cig ces// blo ni rtag tu gom par bya// ci ltar lus ngag yid gsum gyi// rnam pa gzhan gyi don 'gyur bar// nyon mongs bcas kyang blo'i mthu// 'gro la phan par spyad par bya// ci ltar phyi rol yul sna tshogs// nus ldan nus ldan min snang yang*// chos rnams ro gcig nyid yin zhes// stong pa nyid la bzod par bya// brtson pa'i stobs chung nyid 'gyur kyang*// byang chub 'gyur ram mi 'gyur zhes// the tshom gyur pa'i blo spangs nas// rtag tu rgyal sras rjes su slob// rtog dpyod la sogs bsam gtan rnams// mngon du thob par ma gyur kyang*// dran rig 'gyu ba sna tshogs 'di// ma yengs shes rtse gcig bskyangs// shes rab lam la 'jug pa'i sgo// thos bsam rnam par brtson pa yi// rgyal ba'i gsungs rab la sbyangs bya// chos rnams gdod nas rnam dag pa// skye 'gag nye bar zhi ba'i don// gzugs sogs 'du mi byed pa yi// don la rtag tu blta bya zhes// 'jam dpal gyi ni gang gsungs pa// dbu ma'i rjes su 'jug par bya// de ltar rgyal sras rnams kyi legs gsungs shing*// bla ma dam pa rnams kyi mdzad pa ltar// bsgrub par mi nus brtson pa'i mthu chung ba// rang byung ming can gyis sbyar bar yin// zhes bgyi ba'i mgur ma 'di ni/

chos rje rang byung rdo rjes gangs yar lha sham po'i 'gul gser khung chung mdo zhes bya ba na bzhugs pa'i dus/ shin du bsnyung bar gyur nas zhing gzhan du gshegs dgos snyams pa'i thugs dgongs shar cing*/ slar yang 'dir las dang nyon mongs kyi mnar ba'i sems can rnams la thugs snying rje chen po skyes nas gsungs pa'o/// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ gnas rgya gar yul du sgra che ba// na ro mai tri ma lags sam// de'i rjes 'jug lho brag pa/ skyes mchog bzhad pa'i rdo rje dang*// zla 'od gzhon nu dus gsum mkhyen// dgos ched gcig gda' na thugs la zhog /sangs rgyas zhing khams thams cad ni// gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi skad pa de// phyi rol bden par grub pa med// rang lus rtsa'i 'khor lo yin// khyad par gnas chen thams cad la// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro zer ba de// khams dang thig le bzhugs pa yin/ khams dang thig le skad pa de// mi phyed pu li ra yin te// skra dang sen mo 'bab pa yin// de bzhin gnas rnams thams cad la// khams nyi shu rtsa bzhi 'bab pa lags// khyad par rtsa gsum sbas pa'i rtsa// ro rkyang a wa dhū ti yin// thabs shes dbyer med zung 'jug la// rten 'brel sna tshogs gnad du bsnun// 'khor 'das gnyis med rang ngo mthong*// gnas chen zhes su rgyal bas gsungs// bde gsal mi rtog ye shes 'char// sbas pa'i rtsa lnga gnas mchog ste// mkha' 'gro lnga po bzhugs pa yin// rlung rnam dag mkha' 'gro'i ngo bo nyid// gzugs snang stong sgyu ma ltar bur 'char// sgra grags stong dbyer med chos kyi sgra// dri snang stong tshul khrims dag pa'i dri// ro snang stong zhen med chos kyi ro// yid zag med bde ba chen por 'char// de sgo lnga dag pa'i dngos grub ster// nang sbas pa dhū ti'i rang bzhin te// 'khor 'das dbyer med mkha' 'gro yin// dbyings spros bral dag pa'i nam mkha' la// ye shes rang grol snang ba 'gro// 'khor 'das dbyer med rang bzhin te// de rtogs na thar pa'i grogs su 'gro// phyi rol gnas su rtog pa de// yul la mngon zhen skyes pa yin// dus mtha'i rnal 'byor rdo rje yis// phyi rol gnas kyi spros pa chod// yul sum cu rtsa drug rang la rdzogs// khams rnam dag dpa' bo'i rang bzhin mthong*// rlung rnam dag mkha' 'gro'i rang bzhin mthong*// bde chen zung 'jug rang ngo shes// da the tshom gyi spros pa mi gda'o// bgegs bying rgod kyi rkyen gyi nyams nga med// nga seng ge lta bu'i rnal 'byor pas// thabs mkhas ri sul brten nas su// log lta'i ri dwags skrag par byed*// gzung 'dzin gnyis la rgyal nas thal// de mkhyen nam dus mtha'i skyes bu kun// sems nang du khug la mnyam par zhog

/thams cad sems su ma shes na// phyi rol ltas kyang go ba med// rang sems gcig pu gom par gyis// yul snang sgyu ma lta bur 'char// rang sems bla ma ma rnyed na// mthun 'jug bla mas don 'go chung*// rang rig ye shes bla ma bsten// 'khor ba rang grol byin rlabs 'byung*// nang gsan pa sgra'i rten 'brel ltos// tshig spros med rang grol shes na mchi// 'bad med kyi snying rje ma skyes na// phyogs ris kyi snying rje 'khor ba'i rgyu// phyogs med rang grol snying rje bsgom// 'bad med 'gro don shugs las 'byung*// ces pa'i mgur ma 'di stag lo la ga ram spangs su gsungs so/// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la gus par phyag 'tshal lo// sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te// yang dag ma yin kun rtog 'khor ba'i gzhi// de nyid rang grol rtogs na mya ngan 'das// rang bzhin rnam par dag pa gzhi'i don// ma rtogs 'gro la snying rje cher bskyed nas// 'phags lam dam chos ston pa'i bla ma la// mos pa bskyed cing brtson 'grus rab brten pa// lam la 'jug pa'i gzhi ru shes par bya// des brten pha rol phyin drug rdzogs bya'i phyir// zhi gnas lhag mthong lam la 'jug pa dang*// thabs mkhas rtsol pa'i gnad kyi legs zin pas// 'phags pa'i lam du 'gro ba'i gtso bo yin// rnam rtog mtshan ma bral ba'i shes rab dang*// de bzhin nyid la dmigs pa'i bsam gtan gyi// chos can chos nyid ma nor mthong nas kyang*// srid zhi gnyis las grol ba'i 'bras bur 'jug /dri med rgyal ba'i snying po rang bzhin la// glo bur sgrib pa'i tshogs rnams dang pa'i tshe/ sku dang ye shes mdzad pa 'phrin las kyis// 'khor ba ji srid 'jug pa'i nus mthu 'byung*// rgyal bas gsung pa'i gzhi lam 'bras bu'i don// thun mong ma yin gnad kyi gdams pa 'di// 'gro ba kun gyi don du 'gyur bar shog

/ces pa 'di sprel lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bco brgyad la rang byung rdo rje'i/ 'dam du rwa sgrengs pa dpon slob la gdams pa'o/// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ dal 'byor mi lus rin chen thob dus 'dir// theg chen bla ma dam pa brten pa dang*// bslab gsum dri med bsrung la brtson par bya// sems can kun la snying rje chen po bskyed// ma yengs rtse gcig bsam gtan rgyun du bsgom// sna tshogs snang ba sems kyi sgyu ma mkhan// skye 'gag med kyang snang ba rmi lam 'dra// blang dor byas na 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bskyed// rang snang rang grol snang yang bden med phyir// mtshan 'dzin med par shes rab ngo bor bzhag /gshis de rtogs pa rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ste// ma yengs dran pa'i rgyun dang ldan par bsgom// thun 'tshams bsngo ba smon lam legs zin byas// 'di ni chos rnams kun gyi snying po yin// rtag tu nyams su len la brtson par mdzod// zhes bya ba 'di chos rje rang byung rdo rjes lug lo la bde chen du shes rab seng ge la gdams pa'o/// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i snyigs ma'i dus 'di ru// rtse gcig sgrub la brtson par ma byas na// rgas nad 'chi ba rtag tu rjes 'brang pa'i// 'khor ba'i gnas na thon pa shin tu dka'// rnam par rtog pa'i mtshan mar 'dzin pa gang*// 'du byed g.yo ba'i rkyen las byung ba'i phyir// de nyid chod na 'khor ba'i rtsa ba bton// rang sar chod par 'gyur bar shes par bya// ci snang sgyu 'drar rtog pa'i 'gog pa yi// srid zhi mnyam pa nyid du grol 'gyur te// skye 'gag med pa'i rang sems lhan cig skyes// de nyid mngon sum rtogs par bya ba'i phyir// 'phags lam snying po zhi gnas lhag mthong ste// ma yengs dran pa'i brtson 'grus ma bral ba// ting 'dzin shes rab zung du 'brel ba yi// rgyal ba rnams kyi lam mchog rnyed par 'gyur// de nyid nyams len pa yi dus su ni// le lo g.yengs ba'i bdud kyi gegs byung tshe// 'dun pa brtson dang dran pa legs par skyed// gdams pa brjed na mdo rgyud bstan bcos blta// bying rgod byung na rang ngo dran pas sel// 'du mi byed na gnyan po'i shes rab bskyed// 'du byed g.yo na gsal stong ngang du bzhag

/tshul 'di rgyal ba kun gyis bsngags pa yi// gdams pa kun gyi snying po bsdus pa yin// de ltar rtag tu nyams su blang bar mdzod// ces pa 'di ni/ chos rje rang byung rdo rje yis/ dkon mchog seng ge la gdams pa'o/// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ gdams pa rnams kyi don kun bsdus pa ni// bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag legs thob nas*// zhi gnas lhag mthong gom par byed pa la// rtog pa'i 'gyu ba gsal stong rtse cig tu// g.yo med gnas pa zhi gnas ngo bo yin// gzugs sogs yul snang rang gi sems kyi dngos// rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur snang ba 'di// 'dzin byed rnam par shes pa'i tshogs drug po// rang gis ngo bo gsal stong skye med du// rtog pa stong pa'i rang ngo mthong ba ste// 'gags med rig pa'i rtsal la shar ba yi// dkar nag rgyu 'bras rten 'brel 'gag med par// blang dor tshul shes de yang spros bral du// rtogs shing ma rtogs kun la snying rje skyed// de nyid lhag mthong zhes su rgyal bas gsung*// de gnyis dbyer med gcig tu nyams len pa// theg chen lam gyi gzhung du bshad pa yin// de don rtogs pa'i bog 'don gegs sel ni// nyon mongs gzung 'dzin 'khor ba'i gegs yin te// zhi lhag yon tan mngon shes ting 'dzin la// 'ga' zhig mtshan mar 'dzin na de yang gegs// rgyu 'bras blang dor bden 'dzin gegs yin te// bden med stong par 'dzin na de bas 'khrul// de phyir rnal 'byor nyams kyi snang ba dang*// yon tan gang la yang ma zhen rtsol med sbyang*// snying rje chen po'i sems can don byed cing*// dge ba kun spel bsod nams rgya chen 'debs// sangs rgyas chos kun shes shing rtogs par 'dod// de yang gzhan gyi don du yongs su bsngo// de dag kun yang chu zla lta bu ru// ma yengs dran pa'i rgyun gyi brtan byas na// dngos dang dngos med bdud kyi tshugs mi 'gyur// sangs rgyas yon tan tshogs rnams rab tu 'phel// rgyal ba sras bcas kun gyi bsngags 'gyur zhing*// ring por mi thogs 'bras bu thob 'gyur nas// 'di ltar bsgrub la mngon par brtson par mdzod// zhes bya ba 'di ni/

chos rje rin po che rang byung rdo rje'i yos bu lo zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bcu bdun kar ma'i ri khrod sgang dgon du gsungs so// 'di ltar nyams su blang na dpe cha mang po mi dgos gsungs so/// // ༈ na mo gu ru/ kyai ho dpal ldan 'gro mgon rin po che// skal ldan bdag la byin gyis brlabs tu gsol// bdag 'dra blo dman rnal 'byor ri khrod pa// rang la gros 'debs gsal ba'i me long bri// dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rje// skal ldan lam sna drang du gsol// rje la gsol ba btab lags pas// snying la gdams ngag bdud rtsi zhugs// dam chos thugs kyi snying khu phyung*// snying nas gdams ngag byon lags kyang*// bdag gi bsgrub pa ma byung ba// rang gi rang la khrel lo ang*// da ltar 'jig rten snang ba lags// tshul 'chos gang che chos pa bzang*// shin tu dga' bar 'dod lags kyang*// 'chi dus 'gyod dogs yod do ang*// gzhan skyon mthong bas rang skyon dran// bdag bstod gzhan la smod byed pa// ma 'dris tshe na bden bden 'dra// 'dris na khrel dgos yod do ang*// 'di'i bde ba yud tsam la// bltas nas khe dang bsogs 'jog byed// rtag med sgyu ma lta bu la// gzhan nas rang rgyal ma byed ang*// da lta 'jig rten 'di nyid du// me stags tsha tsha mi bzod na// rig drug bar do'i sdug bsngal la// bzod re byed pa 'khrul lo ang*// da ltar bdag gi yid 'di la// tshig ngan tsam yang mi bzod na// gzhan la tshig ngan smra ba ni// 'khrul ba bas kyang 'khrul lo ang*// 'khor ba pa la bde ba med// srid pa'i mu mthar thug pa yi// sdug bsngal rnam pa bgrang mtha' yas// 'di la zhen par ma byed ang*// phyi'i yul drug dper bzhag nas// rang gi skyon drug rtog mdzod la// spongs la yon tan drug po longs// 'bras bu drug po 'byung ngo ang*// bder gshegs bka' dang bla ma'i gsung*// thos nas mtha' ru 'don bya zhing*// nang nub rgyun du skyon brtags te// skyon de spangs zhing yon tan bsgrub// de la rgyun du 'bad gcig angs// yon tan kun gyi gter gyur pa// bla ma sangs rgyas kun dag la// nges shes chen po rgyun du bsgom// gsungs sgrub byang chub thob po ang*// a tsa ma na sems can rnams// yi re mug na 'khor ba tsho// ya re chad na 'khrul snang can// rang la zhe khrel sgom gcig ang*// rtag pa med do 'khor ba yi// mtshan nyid sgrib g.yog 'thug po yi// sgrib pas da rung 'khor bar 'khyam// rang la yi mug sgom gcig ang*// 'khor ba don med sdug bsngal rgyu// snying po med pa yin pa la// da rung rtag pa'i mtha' btsan bzung*// snang sems gnyis ka 'khrul lo ang*// kun rdzob rgyud du snang ba yis// zhen pa dang bcas rang gi sems// bzang ngan 'khrul pa bsam mi khyab// 'di la bden 'dzin ma che ang*// 'jig rten sgyu ma lta bu la// dngos 'dzin byung na bdud kyi las// yin par shes par gyis mdzod la// bden 'dzin ma byed thong gcig ang*// gzhan skyon ci tsam snang ba de// bdag la'ang de tsam yus yod kyis// gzhan la yang khrel du ma lta bar// rang la bsam gzhig thong gcig ang*// bla ma dam pa'i bka' drin gyis// lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'di// spro bral chos sku'i ngo bo de// brjod yul blo las 'das song*// bdag 'dra'i rnal 'byor ri khrod pa// lto gos gtan nas med lags kyang*// gtum mo'i dro dang bcud len gyis// chog pa'i 'dun bsam yod do ang*// da lta sdug bsngal ci byung yang*// sngon gyi dus nas bsags pa len// de phyir rkyen ngan phra mos kyang*// sngar gyi las ngan sel lo ang*// ci ltar byas kyang chos las med// chos byas rang rgyud dul las med// nyon mongs 'dul bar gyis lags ang*// 'jig rten mi rtag 'khor ba 'di// yang dag don las ma 'das kyis// chags 'dzin bden bsams ma byed par// spros med don mchog sgom gcig angs// 'jig rten 'di na gnas pa yi// phan gnod lha 'drer ming btags rnams// don la bden par mi bdog gi// der 'dzin zhen pa thong gcig ang*// pha rol phyin pa'i don mchog nyid// bden med brgyad kyi rnam grangs can// smra brjod blo 'das de rang nyid/

bden med gza' gtad bral lo ang*// de ltar yin yang rnal 'byor bdag /rgyun du bla ma brten no ang*// ri khrod dgon pa 'grim mo ang*// las nag phyogs la 'dzem mo ang*// dkar po rim gyi bsgrub bo ang*// blo skyed rim gyi 'don no ang*// thams cad chos dbyings bsngo'o ang*// bka' drin dam pa 'byung ngo ang*// ces chos rjes rang byung rdo rjes gsungs so/// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ dpal ldan bla ma rin po che// dus gsum sangs rgyas thugs rje yi// kun kyang bde ba'i gnas su drongs// da lta snyigs ma lnga'i dus// chos byed par 'dod pa'i sgom chen rnams// snying nas dam chos mdzad mkhan nyung*// da lta ma dag gdul bya rnams// gos bzang gcig la byang chub re// sngon gyi grub thob gong ma rnams// na bza' med par sgrubs pas kyang*// phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub brnyes// da lta'i dus la bab tsa na// gos bzang med na dam chos med// gos bzang po de la bkur bsti byed// gos ngan nas byang chub bsgrub na yang*// khyod phar song zer nas brang nas phul// chos med gsol bzang byung ba na// 'dir byon zhu zer nas bkur sti byed// de yi pa mi nag pa yi mdzad spyod yin// der ma zad da lta'i chos pa kun// nga mi 'dod zer nas 'du 'dzi bsgrub// a tsa ma na sems can kun// dus gsum sangs rgyas thugs rje yi// gzigs dang dus la bab nas gda'// 'on kyang sems can thams cad la// thugs rje chung ba ma lags te// las ngan can gyi sems can rnams// mos gus gting nas med pa len// 'on kyang sems can thams cad la// sangs rgyas kun gyi byin gyis rlobs// ces gsungs so/// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ pha bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bka' drin can la skyabs su mchi// dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs// bdag 'dzin grol bar mdzad du gsol// kye ma 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho nas// thar med 'dzin pa'i dba' klong 'khrugs// ye shes chen po'i ting 'dzin gyi// nyi mas bskams par mdzad du gsol// 'di ltar ma rung dus 'di ru// skyes chen rnams kyang mi bzhugs shing*// phan sems ldan pa shin tu nyung*// dus 'dir thugs rjes gzigs su gsol// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i snyigs ma la// chos mdzad rnams kyang hor spyod byed// ri pa rnams kyang grong du bab// rnal 'byor rnams kyang zhing las byed// dge bshes rnams kyang mi mgo skor// kye ma 'di ltar ma rungs pas// snyigs ma'i dus 'dir skyes chen kun// bdag gi tshig 'di go bar mdzod// bcom ldan 'das kyi gsungs pa ltar// nyams su blangs na mi legs sam// nye ba'i ngo la lta ba bas// lta na mdo sde rnams la ltos// kha lan ston mo byed pa bas// mchod na 'phags pa dkon mchog mchod// don med 'khor g.yog bsten pa bas// bstan na ja ma dam pa bstan// tshe 'di'i khe grags bsgrub pa bas// phyi mar phan pa nyams su longs// mdor na 'jig rten 'di'i snang ba kun// rgyab tu bor na legs par mchis// dam chos snying nas mdzad pa rnams// gang la gang zhen med par mdzod// dus rnams ma lus thams cad du// 'gro rnams ma lus thams cad la// byams dang snying rje phun tshogs pas// theg gsum lam la 'god par shog

/ces pa 'di chos rje rang byung rdo rjes dgung lo lnga pa la gsungs pa'o/// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ bla ma rje la phyag 'tshal lo// ri bo gangs can shar gyi phyogs// khyad par tsa ri'i nye 'khor 'dir// dus mtha'i rnal 'byor rdo rje yi// sems la shar nas ngag tu brjod// snyigs ma'i sems can 'dul ba dka'// phyogs med snying rje bskyed pa dang*// rgyal ba'i thugs rjes skyabs ma nus// ma rig sems 'di gti mug che// mi bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa dka'// 'on kyang rgyal ba'i dgongs pa yi// rang don mi 'dod bsgrub po snyams// thabs mkhas spyod pa sna tshogs kyis// skyo med rgyal ba'i bstan la 'bad// gzhan med ting 'dzin rtsal sbyong byed// lus ngag 'gro ba'i don du bsngo// rmu rgod sems can bag med rnams// phyi ma legs par dul nas kyang*// rgyal sras sa la 'god pa snyams// 'on kyang bya blo stor nas thal// yul snang rang sems cho 'phrul yin// sgyu ma'i sprul pa lta bur mthong*// bden med 'ching ba zhig nas thal// spangs blang byo ron mi gda' yang*// rjes 'jug nyams len mdzad pa rnams// myur du brtson 'grus byed re ran// theg chen bla ma'i bka' bzhin du// zhe 'dod med par nyams su longs// mi rtag 'chi ba rgyun du bsgom// rgyal sras kun la mos gus bskyed// bdag med stong pa'i don la brtson// gdams ngag kun gyi rtsa ba lags// thugs dgyes par mdzod cig 'dir bzhugs rnams// ces pa 'di ni lug lo la lhun grub stengs su dbyar bzhugs mdzad pa'i dus/ gong ma'i gdan 'dren byung ba la rkong po'i yon bdag rnams kyi mchod pa 'bul ba byas nas hor yul du mi 'byon pa'i zhu ba byas pa'i dus gsungs pa'o/// / ༈ na mo ratna gu ru/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dus ngan bstan pa'i snyigs mar gyur// rgyal ba'i bstan pa nub la nye// rab byung chos bzhin mi spyod cing*// 'dod nga log pa'i 'tsho ba bsgrub// chos gos rnam gsum mi gon pa'i// ser gzugs rgya ser ber ga can// khyi dang bu tsha khyim tshes rnams// skrogs cing zas la khyi ltar rkam// chos spyod nyams chung chad pas gcod// rdzun dang sdig spyod bya dga' ster// chen po'i tshul bzung chos min spyod// shan pa ma rung ri dwags gsod// chang 'thung dran pa nyams byed cing*// bud med gso zhing 'dod log spyod// rgyal po chos bzhin mi spyod cing*// chags sdang can gyi dbang du gyur// blon po chen por gyur pa yang*// jag rkun rnams kyi dpon byed cing*// bden pa rnams la chad pa 'beb// rkun ma rnams kyi sa steng khyab// lha khang mchod rten 'jig byed cing*// sku gzugs bcom zhing za ba dang*// chos kyi po ti ma rungs byed// de'i rkyen gyi lha srin rnams// 'khrugs ste nad kyi rgyal khams gang*// char mi 'babs cing lo nyes 'byung*// cung zad skyes par gyur pa yang*// sad dang ser bas khyer byed cing*// 'phrogs dang 'joms pa'i mi rnams kun// mu ge nyam thag kye hud 'bod// phal cher lam du 'gyel cing shi// la la gcig sha gcig gi za// la la bu yang tshogs zhing za// kha gcig bkres pa chu ru mchong*// nyin mtshan med par cho nge 'byin// rus 'go pags pas btum tsam dang*// kha cig tshal shing bsregs pa bzhin// yi dwags mngon du gyur pa bzhin// gsod dang 'ching dang brdeg pas gang*// mdze dang phol 'bras rnag khrag 'dzags// dmyal ba mngon du 'ong ba bzhin// gleng bzhi dkar po lam chad pas// dud 'gro mngon sum khyer bas na// mi lus ngan song sdug bsngal can// kye ma 'di 'dra yis dus ngan 'gyur// kye hud sems can snying re rje// mdo khams stod kyis sa 'di ru// rgyal sras rnams kyi ma dgongs sam// gangs can kun kyang 'di 'dra bar// myur du ma rung 'gyur gyi dogs// zhes pa 'di 'brug lo la gsungs so/// /

༈ na mo gu ru/ yon tan mchog gyur dpal ldan bla ma dang*// bdud rtsi'i mchog gyur dam chos bdud rtsi'i rgyun// bltas de skye med mchog de ma rtogs par// lta ba bdag med don la legs par ltos// bdag ni skye zhing skye ba thams cad du// skye med mchog rtogs skye bral bla ma dang*// skye ba kun tu skye med chos sgom zhing*// skye na'ang 'gro don skye med ngang du shog /'khor ba las yid nges par 'byung nas rang la gros 'debs zhes bya ba mtshur phur gsungs pa'o/// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ phyag rgya chen po skad pa de// rig dang ma rig gnyis dang ni// don dam kun rdzob gnyis dang ni// thams cad kun kyang ma yin zhing*// snang ba thams cad dgag bsgrub bral// 'dzin dang mi 'dzin rang sar grol// grol bas stong nyid mnyam pa'i ngang*// nam mkha' lta bu chos kyi sku// gsal dang 'dzin la rnyog pa med// 'dzin pa med pa chos kyi sku// snang stong dbyer med dam chos 'di// sems can kun gyi go bar mdzod// yang 'gro ba rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa thams cad 'khrul pa dang*/ ma 'khrul pa la sogs pa'i snang ba bden med du shes pa'i gdams ngag 'di shes par mdzod/ phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba 'di ni ming tsam du grub pa mngon sum du ma grub cing*/ snang ba'i dgag bsgrub thams cad dang bral ba 'dzin pa med pa'i ngo bo dang mtshan nyid thams cad ma grub cing*/ bde ba dang sdug bsngal ba gang yang ma grub pa'i gdams ngag kun gyis shes par mdzod/// / ༈ oṃ sarba swa sti siddhi hūṃ/ sems nyid nam mkha' lta bu nyid// lus 'di bems po yin pa la// phyag rgya chen po rtogs tshul bstan// thams cad nam mkha' lta bu nyid// go bar gyis cig rigs kyi bu/ ༈ /oṃ sarba swa sti siddhi hūm̐/ don dam chos nyid bden pa la// sems nyid nam mkha' lta bu de// 'byung ba bzhi'i btson rar tshud// 'byung bzhi'i btson rar tshud pa med// 'o na gang yin byas tsa na// rtog pa bsdus pa len pa yin// go bar gyis cig rigs kyi gcig

༈ /oṃ sarba swa sti siddhi hūm̐/ phyag rgya chen po sgom du med// sgom du yod na phyag chen min// sems nyid dngos po rtog rgyu med// rtogs rgyu byung na sems nyid min// go bar gyis cig rigs kyi bu/ ༈ /oṃ sarba swa sti siddhi hūm̐/ nga rgyal btsong pas rdza mkhan bu ru skyes// 'di nas 'chi 'phos dga' lhan gnas su 'gro// 'gro la sems brtse gdul bya gar yod 'byung*// bdag la gzhan don min pa bya blo med// ye shes rtogs pas gzung 'dzin rtsad nas dag /dpal ldan sku gsum rgyal sras thob par shog /gnas skabs bzhi po sku bzhi lhun gyis grub// de ltar bdag gi kyang nam 'grub par shog /ces rang byung rdo rjes la stod byang du gsungs pa'o/// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// mkha' 'gro rnams kyi byin gyis rlobs// zhwa nag po khyung gshogs gser mdong can// zhwa 'di'i yon tan zur tsam bshad// gzhi ma cung zhig sgug pa de// chos sku 'gyur ba med pa'i brda'/ ngo sgo gru bzhir 'dug pa de// tshad med bzhi dang ldan pa'i brda'// khyung gshog gnyis dang ldan pa de// thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa'i brda// rtse mo gsum du yod pa de// sku gsum rang la rdzogs pa'i brda'// kha dog bzhi ru yod pa de// 'phrin las rnam bzhi grub pa'i brda'// dar sna lnga'i brgyan pa de// rigs lnga dbu la bzhugs pa'i brda// gdugs nyi zla gnyis dang ldan pa de// bla ma yid bzhin nor bu dang*// rtag dang mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i brda// dpral bar mdong cig yod pa de// chos gcig shes kun grol mkhyen pa dang*// kun shes gcig tu go ba'i brda// brda de dang ldan pa zhwa nag 'di// bram ze chen po'i dbang zhu yin// mkha' 'gro rnams kyi gnang ba yin// dus gsum mkhyen pa'i dbang zhu yin// zhwa 'di la mos shing gus pa de// dpal dus gsum mkhyen dang mjal bar shog// /

༈ na mo gu ru/ rnam rtog chos sku'i rol pa la// sems gnas pa rkyang pa chos sku min// yan par thong la ltad mo ltos// rang ngo shes na de kas chog /nyon mongs ye shes chen po la// gnyen po bsgom pas mi spongs kyis// rang ngo ltos la nyams su longs// rang ngo shes na grogs su 'char// tshogs drug sems kyi 'char tshul la// yul snang bkag pas mi khegs kyis// gsol ba thob dang nyams su longs// yul snang sgyu ma'i rol par 'char// gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i thib tshul la// sgoms shugs gsal ba'i sgron me theg /gsal snang mthar thug 'od gsal nyams// sgom pa klong du gyur pa 'char// bla ma'i byin rlabs ma zhugs na// kha po smras kyang go ba yin// rgyun chad med par gsol ba thob// ci gsungs bka' bzhin rjes su bsgrub// bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du 'gro ba thams cad smin cing grol bar gyur cig ༈ /dag snang mkha' spyod dpal gyi ri// dus gsum rgyal ba sa ra ha// dbyer med bla ma rin po che// 'gro ba'i mgon gyis byin gyis rlobs// rje btsun de'i zhal snga nas// gdul byar gyur pa'i skal ldan rnams// zhal nas 'di skad gsung bar gda'// nga dang dbyer med sa ra ha// bram ze chen po skad pa de// sku mdog nag la gzi brjid can// rus pa'i rgyan cha drug gis brgyan// dgyes pa'i zhal ras 'dzum mdangs bcas// skyil krung phyag rgya btang snyoms can// mchog gi mos gus chen po yis// nyin bzhin spyi bo'i gtsug du bsgom// mtshan bzhin snying gis dkyil du bsgom// sems nyid rang grol chen po de// rang yan rang grol mnyam pa nyid// yid la byar med chos nyid dbyings// byar med bsam med yengs su med// goms par gyur na mnyam rjes med// yengs med bsgom med sems gnyis bral// 'gro na 'gro 'ong med par 'gro// 'dug na 'dug bsam med par 'dug

/spyod lam spyod bya spyod byed med// nyin mtshan rgyun chad med pa ru// 'od gsal chen po'i ngang nyid du// bsgom bya bsgom byed gnyis dang bral// stong nyid snying rje'i dkyil 'khor du// mchog gi mos gus rgyun chad med// nam mkhas nam mkha'i bsam du med// nam mkhas nam mkha' brten du med// nam mkhas nam mkha' bsgom du med// rang yan rang grol chen po la// rang bzhin nyid la rang thang gnas// rje yi zhal nas de skad gsungs// gzhan la phan phyir yi ger bkod/ 'di las byung ba'i bsod nams kyi// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// tha mal shes pa ngang nyid du// sku gsum rig pa'i rtsal rdzogs shog ༈ /oṃ sarba swa sti siddhi hūm̐/ ye shes sku lnga med pa'i sgom chen la// dug lnga dug gsum rtsa nas langs pa 'di gyong re che// dug lnga ye shes su 'char ba 'di rtsa na ta le gda'// de phyir rnal 'byor gcig rgod shor// thar lam gyi phyin 'di ma rtogs par// tshe phyi ma'i rgyag phye ma thog pa 'di gyong re che// nyams phyag rgya chen po 'di rtsa na ta le gda'// de phyir sgom chen nga cig rgod shor// mi tshe bya byed la skyel ba'i sgom chen la// thar lam byang chub mi thob pa 'di gyong re che// phyin gyis rgyas 'di rtsa na ta le gda'// de phyir grub thob nga cig rgod shor// zhen pa gting nas ma log pa'i sgom chen la// mthar thug phyan mi rtogs pa 'di gyong re che// sku lnga'i sangs rgyas de rtsa na ta le gda'*// de phyir rtogs ldan nga gcig rgod nong*// mi tshe grong du bskyal ba'i sgom chen la// kha 'bar drag du gtong ba 'di gyong re che// dben gnas ri khrod 'di rtsa na ta le gda'// de phyir sngags 'chang nga cig rgod shor// chos brgyad rgyun du byed pa'i sgom chen la// mthar thug don dam mi rtog pa 'di gyong re che// chos brgyad mdud pa yal ba 'di rtsa na ta le gda'// de phyir dge slong nga cig rgod shor// rten 'cha' chu 'thung byed pa'i sgom chen la// tshe gcig sangs rgyas mi thob pa 'di gyong re che/

ye shes kyi thar lam 'di rtsa na ta le gda'// de phyir karma pag shi gcig rgod shor// gti mug ro nyal byed pa'i sgom chen la// bla ma'i byin rlabs mi 'jug pa 'di gyong re che// de phyir sku gsum nga cig rgod shor// nga cig rgod shor ba'i dbyangs chung 'di// ye shes dbyings nas de skad lo// zhes gsungs so/// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bka' drin can la skyabs su mchi// skal bar ldan pa'i skyes bu rnams// ma yengs dar cig snyan gsan mdzod// khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho na// snang dang stong dang dbyer med gsum// mtha' bral gyi ngang du gnas tsa na// rtag chad kyi bdud dang bral ba yin// bu lta ba gcig lta ba de la ltos// bdag med dang 'dzin med yengs med gsum// gnyug ma'i ngang du 'dres tsa na/ bying rgod kyi bdud dang bral ba yin// bu sgom pa gcig sgom na de ltar sgom// 'gro 'chags nyal dang 'dug pa la// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med gsum// blang dor med pa gnas tsa na// mngon lkog gi bdud dang bral ba yin// bu spyod pa gcig spyad na de ltar spyod// snang stong grags stong bde stong gsum// ro gcig chen por gnas tsa na// sgom bzang ngan gyi bdud dang bral ba yin// bu nyams myong gcig bskyang na de ltar skyong*// 'khor ba mu mtha' med pa ru// sdug bsngal gyi mtsho la bying ba yis// mtha' yas sems can thams cad la// 'bul ba bkur sti snyan grags gsum// yangs pa'i snying rjes 'dren tsa na// rtsi gdab kyi bdud dang bral ba yin// bu gzhan don byed na de ltar gyis// bdag zad 'dod zad rtog zad gsum// lhun grub 'od gsal du gnas tsa na// re dogs kyi bdud dang bral ba yin// bu 'bras bu bsgrub na de ltar sgrub// lar bdag 'dzin gyi mdud pa ma zhig nas// gzung 'dzin gyi rtsa ba ma grol na// don ci ltar spyad kyang 'khor ba'i ngang*// tshig ji ltar sdib kyang tha snyad yin// chos dang sems su ma 'dres na// bsgro gleng mkhas kyang gso ba med// gnas lugs gi rtsa ba ma rtogs na// sgom sran che yang tho yor yin// rnam rtog gi 'gro 'ong ma chod na// gcig pur bsdad kyang g.yeng ba yin// spyir chos sku skye ba med pa la// gang zag yengs ba med pa dgos// bsam pas ma zin chos nyid la// dran pas ma yengs brtson 'grus rtsom// sems nyid rig pa'i gnas lugs dang*// phyi yul sna tshogs su shar ba gnyis// chu dang chab rom khyad par tsam/

ma rig 'khor ba'i gnas lugs dang*// don dam 'od gsal gyi rtogs tshul gnyis// til dang mar khu'i khyad par tsam// nyon mongs rang rgyud kyi dug lnga dang*// gnyen po theg chen gyi gong lam gnyis// dug dang sngags kyi khyad par tsam// theg chung nyan thos kyi lam bgrod dang*// theg pa chen po'i lam bgrod gnyis/ mar me dang nyi ma'i khyad par tsam/ deng sang bsgom pa'i 'od gsal dang*// sang bar dor bsgom pa'i 'od gsal gnyis// 'ja' shar ba dang yal ba'i khyad par tsam// dom dam rgyud la skyes pa dang*// thos bsam bsgom pa'i bye brag gnyis// chu dang smig rgyu'i khyad par tsam// rig pa zang thal gyi sgom chen dang*// zhi gnas spob yor gyi sgom chen gnyis// nyin dang mtshan mo'i khyad par tsam// sgom pa mthar phyin gyi sgom chen dang*// da gzod gsar gzhug gi dad ldan gnyis// nas dang ljang bu'i khyad par tsam// khyad par gyi gsal ka de tsug lags// de ltar dgongs gcig skal ldan rnams// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gleng rgyan du shog// / ༈ na mo ma hā gu ru/ byams mgon 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu la sogs dang*// dbyer med bla ma gzhon nu gnyen gcig po// srid mtshor gnas pa'i gzhon nu drangs dus gsol// phyogs ris med pa'i gzhon nu snyan gson mdzod// rab byung tshul khrims bsrungs zhing dad pa can// gzhon nu de ni mtho ris nges par thob// dge ba byas pas ngan song sdug bsngal 'joms// gzhon nu dge ba'i las mdzad ngo mtshar che// srog gcod ma byin len sogs goms pa yis// gzhon nu dmyal ba'i gnas su 'gro ran gda'// sbyin pa mi gtong ser sna goms pa yis// gzhon nu yi dwags gnas su mi lhung ngam// ngag 'khyal gti mug kun slong goms pa yi// gzhon nu'i dud 'gro'i gnas su skye nyan yod// dge ba cung zad nga rgyal goms pa yi// gzhon nu lha min sdug bsngal myong nyan yod// dam chos bzhag nas tshul min spyod pa byed// gzhon nu 'khor ba'i gnas nas thon dus med// de lta bas na rje'i gsungs pa'i chos/

gzhon nu nyams su blangs nas thar pa thob// gsungs rab la mi nyams su mi len pa'i// gzhon nu'i ngan 'gro'i nyams su lhung nyan yod// gzhon nu rnams dgu'i bstan chos 'di/ byis pa rgad po'i gzugs kyi rnam par bkod// gzhon nu rnams la nyes pa bshags// gzhon nu'i bstan bcos dge ba 'di// gzhon nu rab byung rje dang mjal// gzhon nu chos la spyod par shog /ces chos rje rang byung rdo rjes gsungs so/// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ rje 'gro ba'i 'dren mdzad chos kyi rje// sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs// rang sems rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// lta ba spros bral chen po 'di// rnam rtog go yul du ma shor bar/ gang shar gsal stong du 'char ba gces// the tshom blo dang bral na yin// bsgom pa zhi lhag zung 'brel de// nyams myong gi 'dzin pa ma bcings par// rtogs pa rang dbang thob pa gces// yon tan gyi rtag dang 'brel na yin// ngo bsrung bral ba'i spyod pa de// rang 'dod tho chor ma shor bar// rang gzhan gnyis la phan pa gces// sdom gsum la nyes ltung med na yin// lam gyi rtsa ba dam tshig ste// mngon lkog gi sad la ma shong bar// nyin mtshan du brtags shing bsrung ba gces// rtsa ba'i bla ma mnyes na yin// 'bras bu zhi bde'i mtha' ru ma lhung bar// sku gsum rang la rdzogs pa gces// snying rjes 'khor ba 'dzin na yin// lta sgom spyod pa dam tshig dang*// 'bras bu gtan la 'bebs pa'i glu// nags phu dpal gyi dben gnas su// rang byung rdo rjes blangs pa lags// ces pa 'di lta ba bsgom pa spyod pa dam tshig rang rgyud la sbyor bar byed pa'i phyir bris pa lag pas rgyud la sbyor cig// / ༈ na mo rgyal ba kun gyi dngos// rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba nyams thag bskyab du gsol// rten 'brel rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// ma rig sems can rmu rgod la// thabs mkhas rdo rje theg pas gsungs// 'tsho byed sman gyi bu mo ltar// bde bas nyon mongs kun sel// snod kyi thabs kyi bskyed rims kyis// lus kyi tha mal gyi zhen sbyong*// mi rtog so sor sdud pa yi// lus kyi rtsa rnams dag byed pa// bskyed rdzogs gnyis su gsungs pa mtshar// 'on kyang dngos por 'dzin pa dang*// rtogs rkyang du ma shor mtshar// shor na 'khor ba nyid ma 'phags// bgrangs zhing brtsi dang bum pa can// rlung rnams sbyang ba ngo mtshar yang*// rnam rtog sbyong bar ma shes par// lam rtag nga rgyal 'dzin pa nor// thig le byang chub sems kyi gnad// nyon mongs 'phel ba ngan 'gro'i rgyu// 'ching byed mtshan ldan phyag rgya de// me'i rngul chu 'ching ba bzhin// lus 'grub gser 'gyur rmad byung zhing*// bag med khyi dang bong bu ltar// 'di dang phyi mar 'o brgyal ba// smad pa'i spyod pa byed pa nor// rnam mi rtog gi srid pa gcod// stong nyid 'khor ba'i gnyen po ste// rgyu 'bras bskur 'debs 'dod rgyal spyod// chad ltar ltung ba nor ba yin// de phyir rdo rje theg pa 'dis// blo ldan sangs rgyas thob byed cing*// rmong pa ngan 'gror khrid pa yin// de phyir mkhas pa'i spyod yul nyid// legs par rtog la nyams su long*// ces bya ba 'di chos rje rang byung rdo rjes rtogs pa la shar nas bris pa/// /

༈ /na mo gu ru/ skyabs mchog dpal ldan bla ma la// rang sems gus pas phyag 'tshal nas// mos gus ldan pa'i gang zag la// dran bskul gdams pa'i dbyangs gcig len// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las// sgrol ba'i bla ma mjal ba dka'// mnyes bzhin gdam ngag ston pa dkon// de phyir brtson 'grus bya re ran// ngan song gnas gsum mthong tsa na// mi lus gtsang ma thob pa dkon// tshe la long med 'chi rkyen mang*// rgyun du mi rtag bsgom par bya// tshe 'di yis bde ba rmi lam tsam// chags zhen byas kyang rtag pa med// thar pa'i gtan gyi bde 'dod na// bla ma'i gdams ngag 'bad la bsgom// zas nor mi rtag bslu brid yin// 'dzoms yang shi dus khyer sa med// phyi ma rjes su 'brang 'dod na// ci yod thams cad tshogs bsogs gyis// nye 'brel pha ma mthun 'grogs kyang*// 'chi ba'i tshe na rjes mi 'brangs// bslu bar nges pas da lta nas// 'bral med rtag tu yid la bsgom// sems la rang dbang ma thob na// phyi mar gar 'gro cha med kyis// dran pas ma yengs bsam gtan la// rgyun du rtse cig mnyam par zhog /bar do 'jigs pa'i lam 'phrang la// bla ma skad cig dran na yang*// bde ba'i gnas su 'gro ba'i phyir// rgyun du bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom// dam tshig sdom pa bsrung ba na// rtag tu mtho ris bde ba 'thob// lha rnams kun gyi rtag tu bsrungs// de phyir sdom gsum bsrungs la 'bad// lus ngag dge ba chung ngu yang*/ 'bras bu mi zad che 'dod na// snying po sems can don gyi phyir// byang chub chen po'i rgyu ru bsngo/ rgyal ba'i mdo rgyud kun bsdus kyang*// don 'di bas lhag pa gzhan na med// ma bzod sems kyis gros 'debs 'di// skal ldan kun gyi nyams su longs// zhes pa 'di bla ma rang byung rdo rje yis dben gnas nags phu ru gsungs so/// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ chos rje rang byung rdo rjes nags phu dpal ldan gyi ri khrod du/

sbrul lo dgun zla tha chung gi tshes bcu la/ lam zab mo khrid kyi bka' srung la tshogs gtor phul ba'i dus su/ dge bshes ri khrod dbang phyug lnga brgya tsam gyi mgur gcig mdzad par zhus pas/ ci lta bu bya gsungs/ bsam gtan rin chen gyis/ drang don nges don gnyis ka tshang ba gcig zhu byas pas gsungs pas/ ༈ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// byin gyis brlabs par mdzad du gsol// rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i snyigs ma la/ nyams su len na 'di ltar mdzod// snang ba mi rtag sgyu ma 'dra// ma rtogs blang dor 'khrul pa'i rgyu// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bskyed par byed// ma rig bdag 'dzin spang bya lags// rnam rtog 'du byed las kyi rgyus// khams gsum sred lan 'tshams sbyar nas// skye 'chi zo chus khyud mo 'dra// 'di la thar bar bya ba gces*// rnam rtog dkar nag las kyi mthus// bde sdug 'bras bu so sor myong*// dran pa ma yengs bya ra mdzod// rgyal ba'i gsung dang mthun pa lags// rnam rtog smig rgyu lta bu yis// 'khor 'das so sor 'dzin mod kyang*// ma rig rtog pa dag pa na// mya ngan 'das pa de rang yin// rtog byed lam gyi man ngag rnams// nyon mongs zhi ba'i bsam gtan dang*// rang grol rtog pa'i shes rab gnyis// mnyam por sbyor na de ru 'dus// mthar thug rang gi sems nyid la// rtogs pa'i dri mas ma gos par// sku dang ye shes rgyas pa de// sangs rgyas zhes byar gsungs pa yin// zhes gsung pa dang*/ yang zhus pas/ rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len gcig gsungs par zhus pas/ yang gsungs pa ni/ ༈ rdo rje 'chang chen chos kyi sku// rin chen rgyud pa'i bla ma rnams// thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs su gsol// 'dir tshogs rnams la byin gyis rlobs// rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud rnams las// gzhi lam 'bras bu gsungs pa de// rang lus rdo rje'i gnas lugs ni// stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi// rtsa dang gtso bo bcu gnyis la// 'khor stong stong yod pas brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong chos kyi phung po dang*// nyi khri gcig stong drug brgya'i rlung*// skyes bu tshe lo brgya pa la// bye ba bdun cu don bdun dang*// sa ya bdun dang 'bum phrag drug

/de snyed chos kyi sgom yod cing*// dwangs snyigs sum cu rtsa bdun dang*// 'dod dang mi 'dod rtog pa'i tshe// bdun cu don gnyis la brten pa'i// ye shes gnyen po de snyed yod// gnas skabs bzhi dang sku bzhi yi// don las mkhas par gyur pa na// rdo rje theg pa'i lam rim yin// rtsa rlung rnam par dag pa dang*// thig le 'dzag med dbang thob pas// ye shes rang byung mnyam mkhyen pas// rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer med par// srid zhi spangs pa'i dbang thob pa// rdo rje theg pa'i rnam mkhyen te// e ma ngo mtshar snying po'i don// rgyal sras gsang ba'i bdag po yi// thugs rje'i mthu las byung ba lags// skal ldan rnams kyi mkhyen par mdzod// zhes gsungs so// yang 'dus pa rnams la nyams len la bskul ba'i phyir gsungs pa/ ༈ kye ma bstan pa'i snyigs ma la// rgyal ba'i bstan dang mjal bar dka'// theg chen gdams pa thob pa nyung*// thugs rje ldan pa'i bshes gnyen kun// dag pa'i zhing du gshegs kyi gda'// ming yang sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'dra// rtag pa'i dngos po ma yin pa'i// thugs rje ldan pa'i bshes gnyen kun// dag pa'i zhing du gshegs kyi gda'// ming yang sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'dra// rtag pa'i dngos po ma yin pa'i// theg chen nyams len the tshom gcod// rang gi sems la bskul ma thob// myur du brtson 'grus mtha' ru byung*// de 'dir bzhugs rnams la zhus pa lags// dge ba byang chub lam du bsngo// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ dwags po bsgom chen rdo rje rin chen gyis/ deng sangs rin chen thugs rjes ma gzigs na/ sems can la skyabs mi 'dug pas/ thugs rje skyo ba mi mdzad par zhu/ zhus pas lan gsungs pa/ bdag mchis rnal 'byor 'dug pa 'di// sngon bskal pa grangs med snga rol nas// skyabs thub pa chen pos rjes su bzung*// byang chub lam la 'dun pa yod// mar gyur khams gsum sems can rnams// byang chub lam drangs pa'i phyir// kun tu bzang gi smon lam ltar// snying rjes lam log rnams la brtse// mi bdag la bskul ma mi 'tshal gyis// bu sgom chen pa rnams gzob las mdzod// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyang*// rtag tu dran pa'i mos gus yod// 'di nas shar phyogs zhing khams nas// gang gā'i bye snyed 'das pa na// rgyal ba ri rab lta bu bzhugs// 'jam dpal zhing dang mnyam pa yi// rgyal sras dpag med gyis gang pa// da lta yid la dran gyi gda'// mi bdag la zhum pa mi bdog gi

/bu sgom chen pa rnams thugs rgya bskyed// sna tshogs rgyal ba'i bka' rnams la// spyi don tshul dang mthun par go /da rung phyi ma'i mthar thug par// chog shes med par mngon du byed// mi bdag la bskul ma mi 'tshal gyis// bu sgom chen pa nas brtson 'grus bskyed// med kyang ku re bgyis pa lags// 'gro kun byang chub thob par shog / ༈ na mo gu ru/ sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las// thar pa'i gling du 'dren mdzad pa'i// skyabs kyi mchog gyur bla ma rje// sangs rgyas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag mchis rnal 'byor 'dug pa 'di// dal 'byor mi lus legs par thob// theg chen bla ma rnams dang mjal// rgyal ba'i bka' la rang byan tshud// 'di dus bsgrub la mi brtson par// le lo byed na rang la ngan// bslab gsum rnam dag rgyud la theb// blang dor spyod tshul legs par shes// phyi ma'i las 'bras legs par nyid// rang la rang dbang yod pa la// 'di dus bsgrub la mi brtson par// le lo byed na rang la ngan// sna thag mi la ma shor bar// za 'dod longs spyod mi bsgrub cing*// skye bo kun gyi mos shing bkur// rang dbang rang gis thob pa la// 'di dus bsgrub la mi brtson par// le lo byed na rang la ngan// rtsom byed rgyal ba'i gsungs la mkhas// bsam gtan gnad kyi bsgom pa shes// nyams kyi skyon kun sel la mkhas// mkhas pa'i skye bu rnams kyi bstod// 'di dus bsgrub la mi brtson par// le lo byed na rang la ngan// phyogs 'dzin can gyi lta ba zhig /zhi bde 'dod pa'i sgom pa stor// tho co tshul 'chos spyod pa med// 'bras bu re dang dogs pa bral// 'di dus bsgrub la mi brtson par// le lo byed na rang la ngan// 'khor ba sgyu ma lta bur snang*// myang 'das smig rgyu tsam tu go /rgyu 'bras rten cing 'byung bar shes// skye 'gag nam mkha'i skra shad bzhin// 'di dus bsgrub la mi brtson par// le lo byed na rang la ngan// rang la bskul ma 'debs pa'i glu// tsa rir dben pa'i nye 'khor du// dgun zhug bsam gtan byed pa'i tshe// dben pa'i gnas su blangs pa lags// rnam g.yengs skyon rnams dag pa dang*// brtson 'grus sems la skye bar shog

/zhes pa 'di rang la bskul ba'i don du rang rdo rjes dbyangs su blangs pa'o/// / ༈ na mo ratna gu ru/ skyabs mchog thub pa bka' drin can// grangs med bskal pa'i gong rol nas// bdag cag sems can rmu rgod rnams// rgyal sras gzhan gyi spangs pa kun// thugs rje ldan pa'i smon lam can// mthu chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag kyang khyod kyi smon lam bzhin// nus pa med kyang bsgrub snyams pas// rnam rtog rlung po g.yeng ba che// zhe sdang me chen rgyud na bsregs// chags pa'i rgya mtsho gting re zab// 'di 'dra'i sems can skyob pa dka'// chos kun mi rtag bsgrub pa dka'// bdag lta'i dug ro gting nas dam// yul snang dag par bsgyur ba dka'// bdud kyis pho nya nus pa che// thar pa'i gnas lugs mi mthong ba// long ba'i tshogs la ji ltar bya// longs spyod byin na g.yeng bas khyer// med na deng sang bsgrub pa dka'// bsags shing ser sna'i mdud pa dam// tshogs gsog kha len bun skyed 'dra// log 'tsho can gyi sems can rnams// sbyin pas ji ltar bsdu bar nus// phal cher khengs pa nga rgyal smra// phan tshun rdzun gyi mgo bo skor// dge bshes g.yo sgyu phra ma byed// pha dang ma la tshig rtsub smra// theg chen chos la 'phyar ka gtong*// 'di dus snyan smras bsdu ba dka'// dam chos byed na gti mug che// bsgom du bcug na grong yul 'grim// dka' ba spyad na gzhan du 'gro// 'dod yon spyod na 'khor bar 'khyams// rgyal sras spyod pa tho cor 'dzin// don mthun bsdu bar su yi nus// dge bcu spyod pa shin tu nyung*// dben par bsdad kyang g.yeng bas khyer// chos bzhin spyod na 'khor bsdus zer// mi dge spyod pa dpon du bkur// rgyal sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis kyang*// don spyod bya bar ci ltar nus// kye ma 'di 'dra'i sems can rnams// rgyal ba'i thugs rjes myur du drongs// bdag kyang spyan ras gzigs dbang ltar// thugs rje'i rnam thar 'byongs pa dang*// sgyu ma'i rnam thar rgya mtsho yis// mthu stobs 'gro ba 'dren par shog

/ces pa thub pa'i thugs rjes smon pa'i mgur/ rang byung rdo rjes dben par bris/// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// snyigs dus sems can dmu rgod rnams// zhi zhing 'dul bar byin gyis rlobs// rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i snyigs dus 'dir// skyes pa'i sems can nyon re mongs// mi khoms 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'di// gting mtha' med par yi rang*// rnam rtog ma dul sems bskyed 'di// gzhan la phan pa shin tu nyung*// kha len pa'i sbyin gtong 'di// bsod nams 'bras bu shin tu nyung*// mngon lkog can gyi tshul khrims kyi// dal 'byor 'bras bu rnyed par dka'// dbang med thabs rdug bzod pa de// sgom kyang sdug pa'i snon pa yin// log par spyod pa'i brtson 'grus 'di// thar pa'i mi mthun grogs su gda'// rang bde 'dod pa'i bsam gtan 'di// bsgom kyang nyon mongs 'khor ba'i grogs// nga rgyal bcings pa'i shes rab 'di// che yang bdud kyi pho nya yin// kha lta stong pa'i 'ud rgog de// bzang yang chos spong las la nye// rnam rtog ma dul bsgom pa de// bzang yang dug 'dres zas dang 'dra// rang gzhan mi phan spyod pa des// mkhas kyang ngan 'gror khrid par byed// re dogs can gyi 'bras bu de// kim pa ka'i 'bras bu 'dra// dam tshig 'gal ba'i sngags pa de// gshin rje'i pho nyas zin pa lags// tshul khrims mi bsrung btsun pa de// shi nas dmyal bar 'gro ba lags// phyug po nor la chags pa de// yi dwags gnas su skye bar byed// gti mug ngag 'chal smra ba de// dud 'gro rin gyi nyos pa lags// khyim 'dris zhen pa byed pa de// mi dge ngang gis 'phel bar 'gyur// grong yul 'grim la dga' ba de// log 'tsho spel bar byed pa lags// snyan grags sgra la 'dod pa skye// ri dwags sgra la nyan dang mtshungs// kye ma snyigs dus sems can rnams// log spyod 'di rnams spangs nas kyang*// yang dag lam mchog rnyed par shog

/ces pa 'di tsa ri'i gnas sgo dgon gsar du gsung so/// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// shāka thub bstan pa'i snyigs ma la// rang byung rdo rjes 'di skad lo// log pa'i sems can 'dul dka' ba// za rgyu byin na rko long sdom// nor 'phangs med byin na tshur la 'khangs// srog nas bslus nas gnod pa skyel// slob ma bla mas dgra dang sprad// chos zab mo byin na snod mi rung*// dbang rgyun du bskur yang dam tshig med// 'dul khrims mi bsrung tho co byed// zab mo'i lta bstan chad ltar 'gro// mngon sum bstan na rtag ltar 'dzin// kye ma snyigs dus sems can rnams// su yi rjes su 'dzin par byed/ khyad par skye dman gang zag rnams// rnam rtog 'dod pa'i phyogs su 'breng*// phan pa'i zhal lta 'bar bar mthong*// g.yo sgyu can gyi rjes su 'brang*// chos bshad kyang sems la gcig mi rnams kyi gser ma spyod// mi bdag gi rnying rje skyes mod kyang*// dus snyigs ma 'di la thul bar dka'// de ltar res gcig btang snyoms sgoms// phyi mar thul bar smon lam 'debs// rang byung sems la shar ba 'di// skal ldan rnams kyi mkhyen par mdzod// ces bya ba 'di tsa ri'i zhol dgon gsar du gsungs so// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i snyigs ma la// dad par ldan pa'i sems can dkon// dam chos tshul bzhin ston pa nyung*// chos la brtson pa brgya la 'ga'// rang gzhan don gnyis grub pa na// 'di ltar 'gyur ba'i snyigs dus su// rgyal ba'i rjes su slob pa rnams// 'khor ba'i 'dam la mi chags par// myang 'das skam sa snyags re ran// 'jig rten nye du spangs nas kyang*// bshes gnyen dam pa brten re ran// don med long gtam dor nas kyang*// gsang sngags bzlas brjod bya re ran// log pa'i brtson 'grus dor nas kyang*// bsam gtan brtson 'grus bya re ran// zhim mngar zhen pa spangs nas kyang*// ting 'dzin zas la brten re ran// grong khyer sred pa spangs nas kyang*// ri khrod bas mtha' 'grim re ran// de ltar nyams su mi len na// phyi'i snang ba brid pa mkhas// yid kyi khye'u chung 'go lo rgod// rnam par rtog pa'i rgyun ma mang*// bsod nams grogs po shin du nyung*// gti mug mun pa grib ma che// log pa'i g.yang sa shin du mang*// mi dge'i grogs po khrid nas kyang*// ngan song gsum gyi btson ra ru// thar pa ༈ na mo gu ru/ yang glang lo zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bcu gsum gyi nub mo pho brang shang tor rmi lam du byung ba mgur du gsungs pa ni/ thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo// blon po'i tshogs kyi gsol btab nas// spyan ras gzigs dbang sgom thabs bshad// de rjes 'od dpag med pa yi// zhing khams yon tan bsngags pa dang*// ma ṇi pad me'i sngags pa rnams// bdag la shod ces tshig tu smras// za ma tog las bshad pa yi// sngags pa rgya cher bshad nas kyang*// yang ni tshig du 'di skad brjod// gang gi 'di 'dra'i mtshan 'dzin pa// bde ba can du skye 'gyur te// rin chen sna tshogs padma yi// steng du dkyil krung bcas ste 'byung*// mgon po 'od dpag med mthong nas// chos nyid don ni rgya chen mthong*// de la rgyal nas 'dzum pa mdzad// thugs rje'i mnga' bdag spyan ras gzigs// de la zhu ba mdzad nas kyang*// lung bstan rjes su gnang ba mdzad// de nas sems kyi skad cig la// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba mchod pa dang*// sems can rnams la sbyin byed pa// 'jig rten khams ni dpag med par// legs par tshul 'di rmis nas kyang*// sad kyang blo la gsal bar snang*// de phyir ngag tu brjod pa yin// zhes chos rje rang byung rdo rjes gsungs so// shin tu legs/ bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /yang pho brang chen po ta'i tu na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ stag lo zla ba dang po tshes dgu'i nub mo rmi lam du/ slob dpon dpa' bo rdo rje ngas/ mar pa lo tsā tsho la sogs pa'i bla ma 'byon nas/ chos kyi bsgro gleng mang po byed gyis 'dug /de yi bar du tshigs su bcad pa yid la zin pa ni/ gang zhig rtog pas bar bcad na// dga' bde'i ting 'dzin nyams gyur bas// dus ring sgom kyang dgos pa med// rtogs bral gsal bar skye gyur pa// lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin te// mtshan pa'i la sogs btsal mi dgos// gang dang gang la sems bzhag pa// de dang de'i rang bzhin te// sna tshogs gzugs can nor bu 'dra// zhes gsungs pa thos zhing*/
